params.body:
## What the dealer saw

Autobedrijf Gielkens (via Ilse, 2026-09-17): change a price on the sheet, click Opslaan, and the browser asks "This page has expired. Would you like to refresh the page?". Cancel that and the "you are leaving without saving" warning follows. Not reproducible under Ilse's admin account.

## Diagnosis

"This page has expired" is Livewire's built-in reaction to a 419: the CSRF token the page was rendered with no longer matches the browser's session. The likely cause here is the session lifetime: a session lives 120 idle minutes (`SESSION_LIFETIME`) and the login has no remember-me (`LoginController::login` calls `Auth::loginUsingId` without a remember cookie). A dealer opens a sheet, leaves it open over lunch, comes back and changes the price: the server starts a fresh empty session, the page's token does not fit it, 419. An admin who tests within minutes never crosses the 120 minutes; the account is not the difference, the pace is. The leave-guard warning afterwards was correct: the save had failed, so the sheet still had unsaved work.

Less likely but also covered: a login in a second tab (which regenerates the token; the first tab keeps the old one) or a logout elsewhere.

## What changed

- `resources/js/session.js` (new, started from `app.js`): a `Livewire.interceptRequest` hook. On a 419 it calls `preventDefault()` so Livewire's native confirm never shows, fetches a fresh token from `GET /csrf`, puts it in the meta tag, jQuery's `ajaxSetup` and Livewire's script config, and fires the same actions again with `Livewire.fireAction`. Only when `/csrf` answers 401 (the session is really gone), or a retry fails again without any request succeeding in between, does the page show `ui.dialog` "Je sessie is verlopen" with one button "Opnieuw aanmelden" and navigate to the current URL, which the auth middleware turns into the login with this sheet as intended URL.
- Heartbeat: while a `[data-session-keepalive]` element is on the page (the vehicle sheet root), a light GET to `/csrf` every ten minutes keeps the session from idling out. Trade-off, written in the code and the finding: an open tab keeps a session alive indefinitely; closing it ends the heartbeat. Preferred over raising `SESSION_LIFETIME` for everyone.
- Leave-guard: `window.slSkipUnloadGuard` is set before the dialog's own navigation and on any server-ordered Livewire redirect (the order-return after a save). A successful save already cleared the flag via `vehicle-saved`.
- `GET /csrf` (`session.csrf`, inside the `auth` group): `{"token": ...}` for a signed-in session, 401 JSON for a guest.
- `components/ui/session-guard.blade.php`: the configuration element (URL and copy) rendered by the layout for signed-in users; copy in `auth.php` for nl/fr/en/de.
- Rule R S1-9.23 in `11-s1-wagen-invoeren-en-beheren.md`; finding `bevindingen/2026-09-17-prijs-wijzigen-page-expired.md`, open until Gielkens confirms.

## Verified in a browser (headless Chromium, local server)

1. Stale token, live session: the sheet's token was replaced by garbage, price changed, Opslaan. Network: `419 /livewire/update`, `200 /csrf`, `200 /livewire/update`; "voertuig opgeslagen" shown, price 28100 in the database, no native dialog.
2. Session gone: cookies wiped, Opslaan. Network: `419`, `401 /csrf`; our dialog appears (1440 and 390); "Opnieuw aanmelden" lands on `/login` without a beforeunload prompt.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/SessionGuardTest.php`: the endpoint (token of this session, 401 for a guest); the real CSRF middleware (with the unit-test bypass disabled) refuses a Livewire update with a stale token and passes the same request with the token from `/csrf`, and the Livewire endpoint answers it; the front-end wiring (interceptor in session.js, no native confirm, guard imported and started, layout renders the component, sheet asks for the heartbeat, leave-guard honours the skip flag); the built bundle carries the interceptor.

Run green: SessionGuardTest, AlpineExpressionTest, HandlerWiringTest, BuildContractTest, LanguageParityTest, CompiledViewsTest, StylesheetSyntaxTest, VehicleFormSaveTest, VehicleFormStepTest, VehicleFormSheetMarkupTest, RulesCoverageTest, RulesIdentityTest, RulesSourcesTest, RulesDocsBuildTest (66 tests), SmokeTest filtered on ownvehicle (38 tests).

Hot file touched: `resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php`, one added line (`<x-ui.session-guard />` under `<x-ui.dialog />`).

Known limit: when a retried action had a JavaScript `.then` on its original promise (the Volgende button switching the Alpine tab), that continuation does not run after the replay; the server state is correct and the heartbeat makes the case rare.
params.title: Saving a sheet never shows 'This page has expired': the token is refreshed and the request retried
